The ellipsis is in the block's colour, after the text of a span (over its right padding and border), after an inline-block that fits beside it (which hides one that does not, and keeps one that starts the line), on a line of nothing but a
, at the end of pre lines; nowrap keeps one line (no clamp ellipsis, text-overflow ellipsizes it); text-overflow ellipsizes the other lines of the box.
